source_records.title: Wav2Lip: A Lip Sync Expert Is All You Need for Speech to Lip Generation In The Wild (Prajwal et al., ACM MM 2020)
source_records.summary_text: SyncNet-based lip-sync evaluation for generated talking-face video: LSE-D/LSE-C metrics requiring no ground-truth pair, plus ReSyncED consistent benchmarks and human protocol. Gold-standard lip-sync metric family for G08. [retrieval: SUMMARY_CAPTURED; full-body consumption at Evidence stage]

metadata.evidence_boundary: source-local claims only until Evidence verification
metadata.scope_limitation: Metric inherits SyncNet instabilities (see BT-D130); talking-face scope, not general sound-event timing.
